why_selected: Native Falcon-1024 account authorization is live on MainNet.
Official SDK, AlgoKit, and Pera support is reported.
A dedicated account can isolate the pilot from existing holdings and bridge dependencies.
claims_boundary: No asset movement is authorized or recorded by this readiness profile.
Native PQ account authorization does not imply post-quantum consensus.
Native PQ multisig is not yet available according to official developer documentation.
Ecosystem tooling support remains uneven and must be tested before any canary promotion.
